{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the dimensions for the U-shaped profile
width = 70  # Total width of the profile
height = 40  # Total height of the profile
web_thickness = 5  # Thickness of the web
length = 450  # Length of the profile

# Calculate the dimensions for the blocks
# Block 1: Web (vertical part)
x_size_web = web_thickness
y_size_web = height
z_size_web = length
x_web = (width - web_thickness) / 2  # Centered in the width
y_web = 0
z_web = 0

# Block 2: Flange (top horizontal part)
x_size_flange_top = width
y_size_flange_top = web_thickness
z_size_flange_top = length
x_flange_top = 0
y_flange_top = height - web_thickness
z_flange_top = 0

# Block 3: Flange (bottom horizontal part)
x_size_flange_bottom = width
y_size_flange_bottom = web_thickness
z_size_flange_bottom = length
x_flange_bottom = 0
y_flange_bottom = 0
z_flange_bottom = 0

# Prepare the variables for the block function

z_sizes = [z_size_web, z_size_flange_top, z_size_flange_bottom]

y_positions = [y_web, y_flange_top, y_flange_bottom]
z_positions = [z_web, z_flange_top, z_flange_bottom]
subtraction = [False, False, False]  # All blocks are additive

# Return the calculated values
{
    "x_sizes": x_sizes,
    "y_sizes": y_sizes,
    "z_sizes": z_sizes,
    "x_positions": x_positions,
    "y_positions": y_positions,

}"}
